fishing.label: Fishing

mining.label: Mining

woodcutting.label: Woodcutting

foraging.label: Foraging

hunting.label: Hunting
hunting.description: Track wildlife, set traps, recover hides, meat, bones, and trophies.

farming.label: Farming
farming.description: Raise crops, herbs, fibers, cooking staples, and long-term reagents.

excavation.label: Excavation
excavation.description: Recover buried relics, bones, fragments, maps, and ancient mechanisms.

smelting.label: Smelting
smelting.description: Refine ore, coal, and flux into bars and ingots.

milling.label: Milling
milling.description: Turn logs, bark, resin, and timber into planks and construction stock.

tanning.label: Tanning
tanning.description: Process hides, scales, and sinew into leather, straps, and armor stock.

cutting.label: Gem Cutting

weaving.label: Weaving
weaving.description: Spin fibers, reeds, silk, and magical threads into cloth and bindings.

smithing.label: Smithing
smithing.description: Craft tools, fittings, armor, blades, and heavy metal equipment.

carpentry.label: Carpentry
carpentry.description: Craft handles, bows, structures, furniture frames, and ship timber.

cooking.label: Cooking
cooking.description: Prepare food, stews, feasts, field rations, and event provisions.

alchemy.label: Alchemy
alchemy.description: Brew tonics, oils, potions, catalysts, and strange reagents.

tailoring.label: Tailoring
tailoring.description: Craft clothing, bags, robes, sails, banners, and appearance pieces.

leatherworking.label: Leatherworking
leatherworking.description: Craft leather armor, pouches, straps, saddles, and rugged travel gear.

engineering.label: Engineering
engineering.description: Build devices, traps, mechanisms, siege tools, and expedition machines.

enchanting.label: Enchanting
enchanting.description: Infuse equipment, jewels, charms, and relics with magical traits.

jewelcrafting.label: Jewelcrafting
jewelcrafting.description: Craft rings, amulets, settings, trinkets, lenses, and focus stones.

boatbuilding.label: Boatbuilding
boatbuilding.description: Build boats, hulls, sails, fleet cargo, and water expedition upgrades.

furniture.label: Furniture Crafting
furniture.description: Craft furniture, trophies, displays, housing upgrades, and oathhall fixtures.

construction.label: Construction
construction.description: Build settlement projects, fortifications, stations, and world-event structures.

combat.label: Combat
combat.description: Improve overall combat output, tactical reliability, and encounter readiness.

slayer.label: Slayer
slayer.description: Take dangerous marks, exploit weaknesses, and recover monster trophies.

defense.label: Defense
defense.description: Improve protection, guard tactics, armor use, and dungeon survival.

healing.label: Healing
healing.description: Restore allies, improve supplies, stabilize injuries, and support expeditions.

magic.label: Magic
magic.description: Use spells, wards, rituals, and arcane utility in encounters and crafting.

ranged.label: Ranged
ranged.description: Improve bows, thrown tools, artillery support, and distance combat.

exploration.label: Exploration
exploration.description: Scout routes, resolve expeditions, uncover ruins, and reveal world opportunities.

dungeoneering.label: Dungeoneering
dungeoneering.description: Handle traps, branching routes, boss rooms, and dungeon resource planning.

sailing.label: Sailing
sailing.description: Navigate coasts, move cargo, support fleets, and unlock waterborne expeditions.

survival.label: Survival
survival.description: Improve campcraft, supplies, hazard resistance, and wild-region travel.

cartography.label: Cartography
cartography.description: Map regions, annotate resource routes, chart dungeons, and sell navigation data.

reputation.label: Reputation
reputation.description: Earn trust, unlock faction privileges, regional rates, and titles.

leadership.label: Leadership

meteorfall.description: Highguild sparks through the quarry seams and turns careful ore work into better toolmaking runs.

briarwake_hunt.label: Briarwake Hunt
